RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday,  the October 21, 2008/Asvina 29, 1930 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Civil Aviation; Corporate Affairs; Culture; Finance; Heavy
Industries and Public Enterprises; Petroleum and Natural Gas;
Tourism; Water Resources )
Total number of questions — 20
15
Small Savings Schemes
†*41. SHRI MANOHAR JOSHI: Will
the Minister of FINANCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the deposits
in small savings schemes being run through
post offices have reduced due to reduction
in interest rates during the last few years;
(b) whether it is also a fact that interest
rates being offered by banks are higher;
(c) if so, whether Government is
considering to make the interest rate of small
savings schemes equal to those of the banks;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
CNG filling stations in NCR
  *42. SHRI HARISH RAW A T:
SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM
AND NATURAL GAS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Indraprastha Gas Limited
(IGL) has failed to provide adequate
number of CNG filling stations in the
National Capital and NCR towns resulting
in inconvenience to CNG vehicle owners;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether CNG vehicle owners have
to wait hours together to get fuel from the
CNG stations; and
(d) if so, the steps taken by Government
to set up more CNG stations in  the
National Capital and NCR towns and also
to increase the filling capacity of the existing
CNG stations?
LPG supply to Northern States
*43. SHRI AMIR ALAM KHAN: Will
the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) the monthly requirement of LPG in
each State, district-wise;
(b) the quantity of LPG supplied to
each State during each of the last two years
and the first eight months of the current
year, State-wise, district-wise;
(c) whether Government is aware that
there is an acute shortage of LPG in many
States, especially Uttar Pradesh;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

16
(d) if so, whether Government has
received requests from various States
particularly Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand,
Madhya Pradesh and Punjab for increasing
the quotas of LPG in their States;
(e) if so, the details thereof; and
(f) the action taken by Government
thereon?
Appointment of Judicial Commission
on Kosi Floods
*44. SHRI RAJEEV CHANDRA-
SEKHAR: Will the Minister of W ATER
RESOURCES be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any proposal under
Government's consideration to appoint a
high power judicial commission to go  into
the circumstances that led to breach of dam
and embankment of river Kosi in the
Nepalese territory, which caused
unprecedented floods in Bihar inundating
large areas in the State;
(b) if so, the composition thereof, the
terms of reference and time to be allowed
to the Commission to submit its report;
and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
New Civil Aviation Policy
*45. SHRI RAMDAS AGARW AL:
Will the Minister of CIVIL A VIA TION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has decided to
notify its new Civil Aviation Policy;
(b) if so, how much time it is likely to
take to facilitate creation of proposed 500
Mega and 6 Regional Airports as well as to
develop mechanism for aviation grid for
setting up of multi-modal merchant airports;
(c) what steps Government has taken
to make its 100 airports operational, whose
number at present is only 50; and
(d) whether new policy would have
provisions for making 100 aerotropolis in
10 major metros and also establish air
linkages for air passengers for minimum of
50 kms. of distance?
'Adopt a Monument' scheme in
Rajasthan
†*46. SHRI LALIT KISHORE
CHATURVEDI: Will the Minister of
CULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether heritage sites in Rajasthan
are being given to private sectors for their
renovation and maintenance under "Adopt
a Monument" scheme;
(b) if so, the extent to which this scheme
has been successful; and
(c) whether the Government of India
would consider to give archaeological
buildings under this scheme?
Promotion of river tourism in
Andhra Pradesh
*47. SHRI M.V . MYSURA REDDY:
Will the Minister of TOURISM be pleased
to state:
(a) the details of riverine tourism
promoted in the State of Andhra Pradesh;
(b) whether any financial assistance is
extended by the Ministry for promotion
of riverine tourism in Andhra Pradesh; and
(c) if so, the details thereof during the
last three years, year-wise and project-wise?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

17
